text:
anya: heads up, spike in tiny-pod pending in us-east1b for the last 8m, seems tied to node-label rollout + lease refactor. any ideas?
ravi: saw that too. pods are pending attach for >2m then get evicted. scheduler logs show 'lease not found' on some nodes.
carmen: we rolled `nodeLeaseRefactor` to 50% in us-east region ~45m ago. Did we change label semantics?
anya: yes, the refactor flips label `warmnode=true` -> `node-role=warm`. scheduler placement filter still looks for the old label in some paths. so some nodes ended up semi-registered.
metrics-bot: ALERT: pods.pending.us-east1b increased 3.8x, evictions.us-east1b + 230 in 10m. https://monitoring/redwood/pending?range=10m :warning:
ravi: 2 failure modes: (1) scheduler sees fewer eligible nodes -> binpack heavier -> fragmentation + preemptions, (2) attach-controller hits nodes that aren't in lease table -> rpc errors leading to retries and timeouts.
anya: paste from attach-controller logs:
```
E attach: attach request failed node=ip-10-0-22-19 timeout="context deadline exceeded" lease_lookup=node-lease-missing
W scheduler: failed to bind pod tiny-abc: no matching nodes after label filter
```

carmen: hmm. that'll cause pods to linger in queue and then be evicted by our queue-time SLA. what's current queue SLA? 3m?
anya: 2m default for tiny pods. Maybe increase to 6m temporarily while we fix label mismatch.
infra-bot: rollout:nodeLeaseRefactor deployment status -> canary at 18/20 nodes, region=us-east, start=6887652000.
ravi: mitigation plan: (A) pause rollout (scale canary to 0) (B) add a compatibility shim to scheduler that accepts either label, (C) extend tiny pod queue SLA to 6m for us-east1 and (D) add a per-AZ fallback to route new tiny pods to us-east2 if attach errors > threshold. Thoughts?
carmen: +1. Also throttle scheduler rebinds so we don't cascade evictions during fix. Set rebindBackoff=30s.
anya: doing (A) now: `kubectl -n infra scale deploy/nodeLeaseRefactor-canary --replicas=0` -> in progress.
ops-bot: ACTION: scaled nodeLeaseRefactor-canary to 0 by anya at 6887654305 :gear:
metrics-bot: good sign: attach err rate falling but still elevated, attach_latency.p50 -> 500ms.
ravi: applying shim requires a quick configmap patch. I'll push a scheduler patch that checks both labels for 5m window.
anya: also bumping tiny pod queue SLA in scheduler-config for us-east1 to 6m. will patch in 2m.
anya: patch applied at 6887654400: `scheduler.queue.tiny.maxWait=360s`.
infra-bot: scheduler config updated by ravi at 6887654420.
carmen: after patches, watch fragmentation metric: `binpack.fragmentation.p95` and `evictions.rate`. post results here.
metrics-bot: 10m after patches: evictions down from 230 -> 46, pods.pending trending down. binpack.fragmentation.p95 reduced 12%.
ravi: nice. next: audit nodes for stale leases and run a reconcile job to re-register any nodes that missed label update. I'll kick a job `node-reconcile --region=us-east --label-compat`.
ops-bot: job started by ravi at 6887654500, status=running.
anya: cost note: routing pods to us-east2 will increase cross-region egress for some workloads. will run cost estimate if we keep fallback enabled for >1h.
anya: follow-ups added to incident ticket:
- infra: add label-compat tests to rollout pipeline (ravi)
- scheduler: make label filter tolerant for 24h post-rollout (carmen)
- ops: update tiny pod queue SLA playbook (anya)
- cost: model fallback egress cost for 1h vs increased evictions (finops)
oncall: thanks all. keep monitoring for 1h. re-open if pending >50 persists. closing triage for now. :lock:
